title: Categorizer engine + Temporal job: tool-calling agent, category_suggestions table, categorize_run
description: api/src/categorize/. Read-only budget-scoped tools: get_transaction (incl. connection_transactions.raw_payload), list_categories, payee_history, search_similar_transactions. Output up to 3 {category_id, confidence, reason} per transaction, zod-validated, unknown ids dropped. Existing suggestedCategoryForPayee answers first; the rest goes to the model. Table category_suggestions (transaction, rank, category, confidence, reason, source, model, status), upsert on re-run. Never writes transactions.category_id. Job categorize_run, one per budget (subject key = budget id), chunked activities with heartbeat and retries on a rate-limited -ai queue, progress and token usage in the jobs ledger; modelled on connections jobspec/workflows. First step: check whether raw_payload carries a location (lat/long or address) and note the finding on the task. Plan, decisions and owner answers: handoff.md at the repo root. Mock: tk show budget-seoa (evidence ev-c96ced overview, PNGs). Follow AGENTS.md (contracts, migrations additive only + MIGRATION_SIGNATURES, i18n, ports, test DB rules).
notes:
raw_payload finding (before code). `connection_transactions.raw_payload` (migration 0105) holds the provider transaction object verbatim: the Pluggy adapter's `toAggregatedTransaction` sets `raw: { ...txn }` and its zod schema is `.passthrough()`, so every upstream field survives. Documented Pluggy Transaction fields (docs.pluggy.ai/en/docs/products/transactions, read 2026-11-24): id, accountId, date, description, descriptionRaw, amount, amountInAccountCurrency, balance, currencyCode, category + categoryId (Pluggy Enrichment, Pro), providerCode, providerId, status (POSTED/PENDING), type (DEBIT/CREDIT), operationType (PIX/TED/PAGAMENTO_FATURA/...), paymentData, creditCardMetadata, merchant. merchant = { name, businessName, cnpj, cnae, category } — no address. paymentData = participant name/branchNumber/accountNumber/routingNumber/routingNumberISPB/documentNumber + referenceNumber, receiverReferenceId, paymentMethod, reason, boletoMetadata — bank identifiers, no address. **No latitude/longitude or address field exists anywhere in the documented transaction object**, so the mock's map panel cannot be built from raw_payload as it stands. Local evidence: budgetnew_dev on compose Postgres :55432 has 0 rows in connection_transactions (column exists, table empty), so nothing to inspect; rows imported before 0105 stay NULL until their next sync. Useful non-location fields for categorization: merchant.name/businessName/category/cnae, category/categoryId, operationType, descriptionRaw, paymentData.paymentMethod/reason/participant names, creditCardMetadata payeeMCC/installments. Caveat: passthrough keeps undocumented fields, so if a connector ever sends latitude/longitude it would survive, but no documented field supplies it — do not promise a map.
Built in branch tk/budget-fvtx (commit e3cc1cc, 34 files). Files: api/src/categorize/{index,job,jobspec,messages,workflows,activities,chunk,agent,tools,store,errors}.ts + tests + test-fixtures/fake-provider; api/db/migrations/0110_category_suggestions.sql (+MIGRATION_SIGNATURES); api/scripts/e2e-categorize.ts; wiring in api/src/worker.ts (-ai queue), api/src/jobs/workflows/index.ts (bundle export + bundle test), api/eslint.config.js (categorize seams), api/src/budget/index.ts (suggestedCategoryForPayee export), ai port usage (types/adapters/usage.ts + barrel setProviders test seam), docs/architecture.md + docs/decisions.md. Exports for budget-edxg: startCategorizeRun(db,{budgetId,ownerUserId,requestedBy}), categorizeRunStatus(db,budgetId) -> {active,lastFinished}, readCategorySuggestions(db,budgetId,{minConfidence,status?,transactionId?,limit,offset}) -> {rows,total}; types SuggestionRow/SuggestionListOptions/SuggestionSource/SuggestionStatus; constants CATEGORIZE_RUN_JOB/AI_QUEUE_SUFFIX/AI_ACTIVITIES_PER_SECOND/CATEGORIZE_CHUNK_SIZE. Retry policy: timeout retried once/transaction then counted failed; bad_response counted failed; auth/permanent non-retryable stop the run; rate_limited activity retry with provider retry-after capped 15m (default 60s); transient activity retry; one failing transaction never fails the run. Checks: task typecheck OK, task lint OK, full api suite BUDGET_REQUIRE_TEST_DB=1 BUDGET_TEST_PG_BASE=...:55432 -> 1403 pass / 0 fail / 0 skip; e2e-categorize against compose Temporal :57233 -> E2E PASS (16 assertions; real workflow + both queues + ledger counts/usage + no-key stop).
Reviewer note: the 'tk finish' stat card (10 commits / 71 files) is derived from the task's pinned changeset base, which predates the AI-layer merge on main. The actual branch diff vs main is one commit, e3cc1cc, 34 files (+2702 −7): git diff --stat main...HEAD. No other task's work is on this branch.
Independent review of e3cc1cc (attached review-fvtx.md): 6 must-fix, 13 follow-ups; sent back to the omp session. Not approved.
Review round 2 at HEAD 36e950d (41 files; commit 'fix(categorize): address the budget-fvtx review'). Each fix landed with a test that fails on e3cc1cc; verify by checking out e3cc1cc and running api/src/categorize.

M1 tools.ts: get_transaction/payee_history ids are z.string().uuid(); execute() wraps every tool (ZodError -> {error:'invalid arguments'}, anything else -> {error:'tool lookup failed'}). Tests: tools.test.ts non-uuid ids + broken Queryable; categorize.test.ts a model tool guess 'txn_1' becomes a tool result and the run continues.
M2 ai/index.ts: setProviders/ProviderEntry/ProviderOptions removed from the barrel; tests, testing helpers and the e2e deep-import src/ai/providers. routes.test.ts asserts the barrel lacks setProviders again. api/eslint.config.js lets *.test.ts and src/*/testing import internals, last in the config so the feature zone cannot re-enable the rule.
M3 store.ts replaceSuggestions: any decided row (status<>'pending') -> false; upsert is WHERE status='pending'; chunk.ts pre-checks hasDecidedSuggestion before the payee rule/model when force. A decided transaction is never re-asked, overwritten, or hidden behind a new rank. Tests in categorize.test.ts (dismissed + accepted survive a forced re-run, zero model calls).
M4 store.ts CANDIDATE_WHERE: outflows only (amount<=0; amount 0 still needs a category per the client), live/open/on-budget accounts, no split legs, no transfer links, no non-dismissed transfer_marks, payee transfer_rule waiting/outside (date age <= wait_days or no_match='outside', rule active since creation), on-budget 'Transfer : <account>' payees by transfer_account_id OR name, Reconciliation/Balance Adjustment payees. Client untouched per instructions; candidates.test.ts IMPORTS client/src/domain/register.ts registerCategoryCell and asserts SQL==cell.warn for every expressible row, then tests each exclusion separately (inflow, adjustments, split, upcoming, linked, marked, transfer payee, card payment, off-budget, closed, deleted account; rule waiting/outside vs review).
M5 jobspec.ts: CLASSIFY_MAX_TOKENS=1024 per turn (chatTimeoutMs=60s), CLASSIFY_MAX_CALLS=6 (4 tool turns + answer + one timeout retry, shared budget across retries and 429 retries), CLASSIFY_MAX_TOKENS_PER_TRANSACTION=20000 checked cumulatively, CATEGORIZE_CHUNK_SIZE=5, CATEGORIZE_RUN_LIMIT=100 per run (prepare reports remaining; rest is next run), CATEGORIZE_CHUNK_TIMEOUT_MS=5*6*60s+60s=31min used as the chunk activity startToClose. Pending suggestions are skipped unless job input force=true. Activities resume from Context heartbeatDetails (cursor+counter+usage), verified by readProgress tests and a runChunk resume test (finished rows not re-asked, usage merged). Worker -ai queue maxConcurrentActivityTaskExecutions=1. Choice rationale: 100 txns ~<=600 model calls/~0.6M output tokens worst case with a shared key; typical one call/transaction.
M6 agent.ts final turn keeps tools declared and sends toolChoice none. Anthropic: handle-tool-calls doc step 4 'Send the request with the same tools as the first request' (400 'tool_use ids were found without tool_result blocks'); define-tools doc: tool_choice {type:'none'} is supported. OpenAI: function-calling guide 'set tool_choice to none'. Z.ai OpenAPI documents tool_choice only 'auto', so its adapter keeps tools and omits tool_choice. Adapter tests stub the documented Anthropic 400 and assert tools+tool_choice on Anthropic/OpenAI, tools without tool_choice on Z.ai.

F1 keyset: prepareRun returns the newest candidate (date,id) as the snapshot; lists walk (date,id)<cursor, <=snapshot. Test inserts newer+older rows mid-run and proves no duplicate/skip.
F2 classifyWithPolicy owns one cumulative usage budget and reports deltas after every attempt; chunk progress/heartbeat and chunk result include failed transactions' tokens. Tests: failed-after-tool-turn usage and tool+timeout+retry usage counted once; run-level failure heartbeat carries 7/3.
F3 agent.ts sanitizeReason (controls+bidi stripped, whitespace collapsed, 200 chars) and MAX_MODEL_CONFIDENCE 0.99; source stays stored/reported; overlong reasons truncate instead of failing. Tests in agent.test.ts.
F4 errors.ts failureForProviderError: 400/413/422 -> kind 'request' (per-transaction failure); other 4xx/auth/429 unchanged. Doc basis: Anthropic errors page (400 invalid_request_error = format/content of the request; 413 request_too_large), OpenAI error codes 400 invalid_request_error. Test: 400 fails one transaction and the run continues; 404 stops it.
F5 chunk.ts ignores a payee-rule category outside the visible allowed set (falls through to the model); store.listSuggestions filters hidden/deleted categories+groups and deleted accounts; searchSimilar/payeeHistory evidence excludes hidden. Tests in suggestions.test.ts + categorize.test.ts.
F6 an answer whose ids are all unknown is bad_response and writes nothing; pending rows survive. Test in categorize.test.ts.
F7 fake provider + fixtures moved to api/src/categorize/testing/ (eslint bans the path outside tests); no production import remains.
F8 one provider call at a time per key: categorize/key-lock.ts serializes per owner, worker -ai queue concurrency 1, and a 429 waits <=60s then retries that ONE transaction; a second 429 returns to Temporal. Tests: key-lock.test.ts, rate-limit tests in categorize.test.ts (one retry succeeds; second 429 throws).
F10 store.runActorForBudget is the single function (today the budget owner); startCategorizeRun(db,{budgetId,requestedBy,force?}) derives the tenant and 404s a missing budget. Test: a member requests, run.tenant_id is the owner.
F11 listSuggestions validates transactionId as a uuid -> HttpError 400 invalid_transaction_id (new code in shared/src/errors.ts + i18n en/pt-BR); docs say the HTTP layer checks budget access.
F12 migration 0111_category_suggestions_category_idx.sql (index on category_id) + signature. Checked the shared DB: syscd-app has no TRUNCATE of transactions/budgets/categories/accounts (only food_portion+food_catalog cascade), and transactions already had referencing tables, so plain TRUNCATE was never possible; no new impact.
F13 activities.ts failureLogFields logs {kind, pg_code} (code only) for unexpected errors; unit test proves the message is never included.

Checks at HEAD 36e950d: task typecheck OK; task lint OK; full api suite BUDGET_REQUIRE_TEST_DB=1 BUDGET_TEST_PG_BASE=...:55432 -> 1451 pass, 0 fail, 0 skip (100 files; 85 in src/categorize over 8 files); e2e against compose Temporal :57233 -> E2E PASS (16 assertions; result total=2 done=2 rule=1 suggested=1 remaining=0 input_tokens=40 output_tokens=12). Not done: continue-as-new (noted in docs/decisions.md; 100-run cap keeps history small); inputs-changed detection for pending suggestions (no transactions.updated_at), pending rows are re-asked only with force; cross-pod key serialization relies on the provider 429 (in-process lock + one AI activity per worker).
Owner decisions applied at HEAD b2448a2 (merge of main 20cd7ba + decision commit).

(1) Owner key confirmed: api/src/categorize/store.ts runActorForBudget remains the single function; docs/decisions.md now records it as a confirmed product decision — a shared-budget run uses the budget OWNER's key (own, else the shared AI key when the owner has it), whoever starts it; the ledger tenant is the owner. startCategorizeRun still derives it; test in suggestions.test.ts (member requests, tenant is owner).

(2) No map / merchant panel: store.ts BankFacts is now {merchant:{name, legal_name, cnpj, category, cnae}, operation_type, payment:{method, reason, counterparty_name}, card, ...}, every field optional, from raw_payload; counterparty_name is direction-aware (receiver for outflows, payer for inflows). get_transaction returns it; SuggestionRow.bank carries the same shape to readCategorySuggestions (barrel exports BankFacts); null for hand-entered rows. No location fields. The merchant CNPJ is exposed by this decision; CPF/participant documents, account/branch/reference/card numbers stay dropped. Tests: tools.test.ts merchant-panel shape + inflow counterparty + identifiers still hidden; suggestions.test.ts row.bank from raw_payload and bank null without one.

Main merged into tk/budget-fvtx (client AI key screen, client-only changes) before finishing. Checks at HEAD: task typecheck OK, task lint OK, full api suite -> 1452 pass / 0 fail / 0 skip (100 files); e2e-categorize vs compose Temporal :57233 -> E2E PASS (16 assertions). Evidence attached.
